findings.text: while a merge is in progress the hold path leaves the aggregate dirty, exactly the section's symptom, and nothing re-commits it once the merge concludes, so that session still relies on a later one; the skip itself is argued and narrow.
the hold path has no equivalent of the roster's _refuse_dirty_roster_commit guard, so an aggregate already dirty from an unrelated writer is swept into the hold commit's subject.

justifications.fit: the change reuses the existing _commit_roster_write helper, renamed _commit_state_write, following the state-commit idiom beside reckon/ledger.py:1356.
